prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: candidate book cover, vertical 9:16.
Input images: Image 1 is the original cover and controls the title, symbolic subject, layout, relative positions and palette. Image 2 is a painted style reference ONLY for brushwork and focal hierarchy; do not copy its scenery, person, water, colors or props.
Primary request: Restyle Image 1 as a Group of Seven inspired oil painting while preserving its exact symbolic composition. Dark rain falls on a continuous nearly black wet stone floor with no visible outdoor horizon or landscape. Near the upper-middle, the silhouette of a five-pointed crown rests directly on that ground against a misty silver reflection. Below, a broad red light path on the left crosses a silver-white light path on the right as an X. A large heraldic red fox emblem occupies the left path, a large heraldic silver crowned eagle emblem occupies the right path. At bottom are two separate shallow round metal dishes: the left contains a gold signet ring with fox seal; the right contains a gold signet ring with eagle seal. The space above the crown is mostly dark, holding the title.
Text: exactly "A Crown in the Bargain" once, large elegant legible gold serif at top on three lines as Image 1.
Detail balance: clear identity in crown silhouette, two animals, light paths and two rings; retain enough ring/seal detail to recognize them. Merge rain, paving, scratches and peripheral reflections into broad directional painted masses. Impasto selectively on lit edges, not uniform small marks. Bold coherent dark-to-light value structure with deep navy-black, red, silver and restrained gold.
Critical constraints: There is NO mountain, lake, sea, skyline, sunset, shoreline, skyline or distant landscape. The original is a dark symbolic floor scene. Crown is not floating on water. Keep red fox left and silver eagle right, both signet rings at bottom. No human figures. No extra words.
qa_concern: Full-size pixel QA: exact title appears once; black crown rests on dark wet stone, no invented horizon, mountain or water; red fox left, silver crowned eagle right, crossing red/silver light, two separate signet rings in dishes at bottom. Broad dark masses with selective emblem and ring detail; 864x1536 JPEG.
